entities.name: Tomáš Zíb
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tomáš Zíb, is a retired male tennis player from the Czech Republic. He reached a career-high singles ranking of World No. 51 in July 2005. Currently he is active conducting tennis lessons in Singapore.
